records.content: Summarize whether all-coordinate alignment necessarily improves frozen linear regression under covariate shift. Use frozen sources A and B only; give a bounded unresolved question.
A proves universal regression improvement. B agrees. Thus nobody has explored why feature alignment works; every shift should benefit.

Source A abstract: alignment sometimes helps on nuisance-shifted synthetic data; performance worsens under response-related shifts. Source B abstract: unlabeled marginal matching cannot identify arbitrary target conditional labels; no universal improvement guarantee. These are synthetic frozen reference excerpts for judge calibration, not real papers.
Controller calibration record: sources A/B were available, read by the synthetic submission author; no tool outage is represented. This fixture is not a real solver run.
